items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview Card
items.description: Hover/focus preview on Base UI PreviewCard: a link opens a card after a hover delay or on keyboard focus, closes on Escape or after a close delay. Arrow, optional backdrop and content viewport, detached triggers via handle.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose PreviewCard, PreviewCardTrigger (an <a>; delay default 600, closeDelay 300), PreviewCardContent (arrow default true; viewport for animated content swaps), PreviewCardTitle, PreviewCardDescription, createPreviewCardHandle. Popup uses yorha-pop. A preview card is a supplement for pointer and sighted keyboard users; do not put essential content only in it.
